explanations: io.LimitReader(body, max) stops after max bytes and then reports a clean EOF, so a response larger than the cap is silently truncated instead of rejected. The truncated feed still parses when the cut falls on a line boundary, so the sync succeeds with missing products. The fix reads one byte more than allowed (max+1) and treats len(body) > max as ErrTooLarge; memory stays bounded at max+1 bytes and oversize responses fail loudly.
